payout_value_note: $25 per successful referral; up to $100 per month (4 referrals/month)
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($25-$25 per referral); time: referral share est. 5-15 min active
steps: Member refers friends/family; friend qualifies for membership and opens an eligible account. Member earns $25 for each successful referral, capped at 4 referrals per month.
catches: Friend can open an account in Adams, Cumberland, Franklin, Fulton, or York County, PA (excluding West Shore, Camp Hill, East Pennsboro, Mechanicsburg, and Cumberland Valley). Referred member must qualify for membership for the $25 incentive to be distributed to either party. New membership must remain open for 12 months or incentive is revoked and deducted from the remaining account balance. Deposits federally insured by NCUA.
